sources.snippet: gliner2-multi-v1-onnx ONNX export of fastino/gliner2-multi-v1 for zero-shot Named Entity Recognition. GLiNER2 can recognise any entity type at inference time — no fine-tuning required. Simply pass a list of labels alongside your text, and the model scores every candidate span for each label.
